name: farmingstar-moss-and-ember
description: An offline pixel-art farming, cooking and village-life game.

scripts.test: node tests/immersion.cjs && node tests/systems.cjs && node tests/smoke.cjs && node tests/update.cjs && node tests/expansion.cjs && node tests/compatibility.cjs && node tests/bedtime.cjs && node tests/stability.cjs
scripts.test:packaging: node tests/production-html.cjs && node tools/prepare_web.cjs --desktop-only && node tests/packaging.cjs
scripts.build:macos: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.build:windows: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:desktop:test: npm run prepare:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux dir --publish never

author: FarmingStar
